title: AliExpress: 25% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) @ TopCashback UK
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 25% Cashback on Affiliated Products (Uncapped) @ TopCashback UK

[Satirical] All of my items that I've bought have been affiliated but I'm still pending payouts from a couple from March and several from April (go figure, it's the biggest ones). Some of the orders have been confirmed and cashed out from those months too while some are stuck in limbo. Seems to be unreliable in my experience.
Pending £339.xx
Confirmed £0.00
Payable £0.00
Claimed £132.xx
[Clear] Calling it unreliable is a bit of a stretch when it's still pending and not rejected. They always come right in my experience.
[Satirical] About how many weeks beyond the quoted 11 weeks does it come right in your experience? Maybe I expect too much at 17/18 weeks.
[Techefy] The hard lesson I have learned from all these cashback purchases is that they can jeopardize your ability to get a refund if you receive a bad item in a bulk order.
[Techefy] Very true! Has happened to me a couple of times.
[Clear] Ordering from different stores/listings is usually a non-issue if you have to refund one part as each counts as a separate transaction. Definitely if you order 20 of X from a single listing and you need to return 5 of X, then you'll run into issues.
[Techefy] Ok, that means i can return an item in a bulk order. Is this the same with temu orders as well?
[Techefy] Any good wifi repeaters or signal boosters that can go up to the internet package’s 500 mbps speed?
[aragornelessar] Knew I should've waited but bought from the 20% $30 cap just two days ago :(
[Samson2020] Perchased a Andriod head unit for car that I was going to buy without the extra cashback so if it all goes through thats an nice extra bonus.
[Techefy] Does this also stack with coupons, PayPal discount, seller coupons and coins as similar to tcb au deal?
